name: Skagit County, WA
findings: Skagit County has 393 nonprofit organizations. 179 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 142 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Skagit County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 community organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do community organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Skagit County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 93 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
